externalReferences.scope: NVIDIA documents host pinned memory as a prerequisite for async H2D/D2H overlap with GPU kernels in separate non-default streams on capable devices; actual async copy engine support is device-dependent, excess pinning can harm host performance and nominal API availability proves no throughput.

concepts.name: HOST_PREPROCESS_WORKSET
concepts.hypothesis: Future CPU-side decoding, validation and transformation before GPU work.
concepts.requiredOwnerProof: CPU cores and host RAM budget, original media decode validity, exact input ownership, M08 load and interference must be demonstrated.
concepts.failureBoundary: Parallel decoding can amplify RAM pressure or quality/synchronization divergence; does not imply worker launch.

concepts.name: PAGE_LOCKED_STAGING
concepts.hypothesis: Future bounded pinned-memory staging for transfers, not automatic host pressure budget.
concepts.requiredOwnerProof: M07 host pressure and exact device/copy capabilities, pinned memory availability and current M09 composite member grant.
concepts.failureBoundary: Pinned host pages are a scarce resource; GPU access and DMA cannot be inferred from allocatable memory.

concepts.name: ASYNC_TRANSFER_COPY_ENGINES
concepts.hypothesis: Potential overlap of GPU transfer and compute using properly qualified asynchronous stream semantics.
concepts.requiredOwnerProof: Exact owner-qualified CUDA runtime and hardware copy-engine facts, pinned staging, non-default streams, dependencies and measured M08 concurrency.
concepts.failureBoundary: Async API can return early while operations serialize; an advertised GPU does not prove concurrent engine availability.

concepts.name: BOUNDED_PREFETCH_QUEUE
concepts.hypothesis: Speculative decoded-input/model artifact prefetch with explicit owner-scoped backpressure.
concepts.requiredOwnerProof: M55 storage access and retention, M53/M54 model/content rights, M09 resource authority, M11 process and M12 placement proof.
concepts.failureBoundary: Prefetch can crowd out interactive work or reintroduce deleted/unlicensed bytes; not an M09 reservation.

concepts.name: LOCALITY_TRANSFER_SHAPING
concepts.hypothesis: Study batch sizing, read locality and reduced host/device roundtrips as nonadmitted candidates.
concepts.requiredOwnerProof: Actually measured M08 end-to-end p50/p95 and copy/compute decomposition, exact M07 topology and M01 output fidelity.
concepts.failureBoundary: Fewer transfers may require excess RAM/VRAM, stale data, bad tail latency or silent color/precision changes.

concepts.name: IO_DECODE_RECOMPOSITION
concepts.hypothesis: Investigate separate read, decode, inference and recomposition bottlenecks across video/audio/3D.
concepts.requiredOwnerProof: M04 temporal and multimodal synchronization, M06 exact mixed lineage, M55 physical I/O and M08 workload-specific measurements.
concepts.failureBoundary: A faster pipeline can generate gaps, reorder frames or corrupt audio alignment and cannot self-accept output.

concepts.name: PLATFORM_STORAGE_ASYNC
concepts.hypothesis: Future platform-specific async file I/O, tiering and spill only under separate host/storage owners.
concepts.requiredOwnerProof: M55 physical storage backend, retention/deletion and M60 process/OS API authorization; no assumed io_uring or Windows parity.
concepts.failureBoundary: Operating-system async queues vary, can exhaust file descriptors and leak tenant objects across unauthorized scopes.

alternatives.name: SEQUENTIAL_CONTROL
alternatives.hypothesis: Measure a qualified read-decode-transfer-infer-write sequential reference before discussing optimization.
alternatives.tradeoff: Without exact matched inputs, thermal state and current interference, all speedup ratios are ungrounded.

alternatives.name: BOUNDED_CPU_PREP_PIPELINE
alternatives.hypothesis: Potentially overlap allowed CPU preparation of a later batch with separately authorized GPU work.
alternatives.tradeoff: CPU pressure, quality, cancellation, rights, bounded queue depth and M11/M12 permission must be proven.

alternatives.name: QUALIFIED_ASYNC_GPU_STREAMS
alternatives.hypothesis: Investigate separated device streams and host staging only after source owner grants and exact hardware capability evidence.
alternatives.tradeoff: Default stream ordering, missing pinned memory or insufficient async copy engines may completely remove overlap.

alternatives.name: STORAGE_LOCALITY_IO
alternatives.hypothesis: Investigate M55-qualified sequential/queued reads and batching under hard latency and retention constraints.
alternatives.tradeoff: Excess prefetch, cache eviction, excessive pinned pages and physical deletion races may dominate outcomes.

metricProtocols.proposedProtocol: Paired complete real media operation latency including read/decode/staging/compute/recomposition/write and cancellation.
Observed GPU transfer and compute timestamps with exact device concurrency and stream/wait semantics.
Qualified pinned/pageable RAM occupancy, queue sizes, hard memory pressure and host reclaim impact.
Actual allocated, resident and grant-backed peak VRAM with coherent member snapshots and at-use revocation.
Source-qualified physical I/O bytes and latency by tier, including cold storage and restore penalties.
Latency/variance and CPU utilization of exact media decode/encode/format transform per versioned workload.
Observed queue depth, cancelled work, wait time, hard owner cap and foreground priority evidence.
Separate observed temperature, throttle reason, valid sensors, power-limit and contamination under a qualified protocol.
Actual interactive application p95 and protocol-valid external workload overlap, with unknown host-wide sensors flagged.
Independent output quality, frame/audio sync and immutable mixed lineage retained across compared alternatives.
Separate first-run prefetch cost, warmed reuse, invalidation/restoration cost and current physical-storage rights.
Exact source, tenant, work/revision, model/driver, rights, age and responsible owner for every recorded outcome.

questions.question: Which independently observed CUDA async copy-engine and stream capabilities, driver versions and exact hardware subjects could establish eligible overlap?
Which actual host pinned-memory availability and pressure proofs must constrain any future page-locked staging allocation?
Which source-qualified cold and steady-state protocols isolate CPU pre-decode, GPU copy, GPU compute, I/O and recomposition in end-to-end latency?
How should missing host-wide external load sensors preserve UNKNOWN_TELEMETRY instead of falsely certifying clean interference?
Which all-member coherent resource lease and authenticated worker ACK must exist before prefetch or overlapped GPU processing?
How should at-use resource revocation and process cancellation stop future queued DMA and prefetch without inventing OS termination?
Who owns actual physical file reads, cache eviction, object retention and deletion while M13 only proposes read-locality research?
What exact media fidelity, frame order, sample sync and mixed reused/rebuilt lineage proofs must a future overlapped pipeline preserve?
Which current real tenant identity, signed rights and storage authorization prevent lookahead prefetch of revoked or confidential content?
How should hardware-specific M08 measured transfer traces remain distinct from frozen M10 advisory forecasts and unproven nominal PCIe bandwidth?
What measured threshold or positive source proof, rather than nominal VRAM, would qualify double buffering under exact M09 grants?
Which owner-defined bounded queue and backpressure semantics protect foreground interactive latency when CPU preparation outruns GPU use?
Which future physical-storage and OS contracts would authorize platform-specific asynchronous I/O without assuming cross-platform API parity?
How will M02 semantic work identity and M06 revision/attempt receipts fence stale prefetched data across edits, cancellation and branch motion?
What actual copy-engine, NUMA, multi-GPU and topology qualifications avoid claiming peer-to-peer transfer on unsupported paths?
Which exact observed trace can distinguish stream enqueue latency from completion and expose implicit default-stream synchronization?
How could throughput-oriented batching be rejected when it worsens tail latency or M01 quality despite favorable average GPU utilization?
Which separately observed thermal, power and device-throttle causes must be retained rather than attributing all slowdowns to I/O?
How must exact model weights, workflow/codec/toolchain versions and S02 selected-none backend state condition any hypothetical pre-decode overlap?
What complete H01–H04 authenticated source receipt bundle and OS principal proof would be necessary before a future real S04 experiment?

negativeCases.label: ASYNC_ENQUEUE_NOT_COMPLETE
negativeCases.trigger: A host call returns early but DMA and GPU compute serialize because default stream ordering remains active.

negativeCases.label: MISSING_COPY_ENGINE
negativeCases.trigger: Nominal CUDA support is mistaken for an independently observed hardware asynchronous copy engine.

negativeCases.label: UNPINNED_HOST_MEMORY
negativeCases.trigger: A proposed async transfer uses pageable memory and no source-qualified staging eligibility.

negativeCases.label: EXCESSIVE_PAGE_LOCKING
negativeCases.trigger: Too many host pages are pinned and foreground RAM pressure or paging severely increases.

negativeCases.label: PREFETCH_WITHOUT_LEASE
negativeCases.trigger: Future prefetch starts device work using a warm residency hint without coherent M09 lease or genuine M11 owner ACK.

negativeCases.label: REVOKED_WORK_QUEUED
negativeCases.trigger: A complete grant expires after enqueue but before queued work begins and at-use fencing is absent.

negativeCases.label: TENANT_PREFETCH
negativeCases.trigger: Storage lookahead reads another tenant's identical-content object without qualified current authorization.

negativeCases.label: DELETED_OBJECT_PREFETCH
negativeCases.trigger: Previously eligible cache object is physically deleted or rights-revoked while I/O remains queued.

negativeCases.label: SILENT_AUDIO_REORDER
negativeCases.trigger: Concurrent decode/recomposition reorders audio samples or image frames despite faster wall-clock time.

negativeCases.label: QUALITY_DOWNGRADE
negativeCases.trigger: A batching or transfer shortcut changes precision/color encoding but an average speedup is reported.

negativeCases.label: MISSING_INTERFERENCE_SENSOR
negativeCases.trigger: Benchmark samples look fast even though host-wide interactive interference telemetry is UNKNOWN.

negativeCases.label: THERMAL_CONFUSION
negativeCases.trigger: GPU power limit and thermal throttling are conflated with storage stalls to justify a transfer strategy.

negativeCases.label: QUEUE_DEADLOCK
negativeCases.trigger: The bounded prefetch queue holds stale work after cancellation and cannot recover backpressure.

negativeCases.label: IMPLICIT_LATEST_EDIT
negativeCases.trigger: A concurrent graph revision moves a branch alias while decoded frames still reference an older accepted work attempt.

negativeCases.label: PLATFORM_API_INFERENCE
negativeCases.trigger: A Linux-specific async I/O behavior is assumed to provide equivalent safety or performance on Windows.

negativeCases.label: FALSE_S04_EXECUTION
negativeCases.trigger: A source-only synthetic checklist claims a real GPU benchmark, storage operation or independent owner contract passed.

stop: No actual CPU/GPU overlap, CUDA stream, pinned allocation, GPU or CPU probe, network, native extension, model load, M55 physical I/O or GC, M09 grant, M11 process, M12 placement, M10 implementation, vendor selection, resource rights, measured speedup, module freeze, authentic independent owner approval or M13 runtime is authorized. H01-H04 OPEN HIGH_FOR_FUTURE_FREEZE; B DIRECTION_ONLY; C01 UNADOPTED_NOT_FROZEN. All original M12/H03 and new M13 S01/S02/S03/S04 real integration negatives remain SPECIFIED_NOT_EXECUTED.
